result.question: Qual o crescimento percentual anual de internações no estado do RS entre 2008 e 2023?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano) AS ano_anterior, ROUND((total_internacoes - LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano)) * 100.0 / LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano), 2) AS pct_crescimento FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY mu."estado", ano ), ano_com_crescimento AS ( SELECT a1.ano, a1.total_internacoes AS total_internacoes_ano_atual, COALESCE(a2.total_internacoes, 0) AS total_internacoes_ano_anterior, (a1.total_internacoes - COALESCE(a2.total_internacoes, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(a2.total_internacoes, 0) AS crescimento_percentual FROM internacoes_por_ano a1 LEFT JOIN internacoes_por_ano a2 ON a1.ano = a2.ano + 1 ) SELECT ano, total_internacoes_ano_atual, total_internacoes_ano_anterior, crescimento_percentual FROM ano_com_crescimento ORDER BY ano;
